en: The head of a creature, mounted on this plaque. Its eyes seem to follow me...
An old "landing machine" that was used in the past for space exploration. It is quite small.
My pet chicken would love this small house, I bet!
This former Grand Protector was the first ever non-Human to fill the role.
This table is so sleek and clean, I can see my reflection!
This machine can print and scan signs.
An odd-colored bed with soft lights coming off of it. Soft lights like these can help Mortals fall asleep.
This machine is radiating with soothing heat. Hmm..
This seems like a recruitment machine. Recruiting for some military, I believe..
You can rather magically spawn a Human out of nowhere!
You can rather magically spawn a guard out of nowhere!
Some sort of disgusting, foul webbing.
What lies behind such a colorful door? I should find out!
I have been told that the feather and ink can be used to create calligraphy.
What Mortal could have possibly painted this? This..this is..extraordinary!
We shall see about that!
Tar that has been shaped into a chest.
From my knowledge, I remember this bed is based off of an old Earth "space shuttle" design. Looks pretty unstable to me.
I would not mind resting again, but I should surely go and hurry to the ceremony.
I hope a Demon does not jump out of this frozen chest.
You can rather magically spawn a metal-skin out of nowhere!
Torn fabric is laying on the ground. Maybe I should pick it up.
You can rather magically spawn a..um, a wizard I think? Out of nowhere!
Uh oh, it would appear I am very late.
These large feathers are arranged like flowers..how interesting.
This must be "Jupiter", one of the planets of the Sol system. Or, si it...?
This is a statue of a beautiful flower. Looking at this makes me feel at peace...
This picture shows the first ever Grand Protector. He looks like he has so much wisdom to share...
This is an ice fluffalo egg. Mature ice fluffalos are a great source of cryonic extract.
This statue is of a creature called "Derrick". What even is this thing?
Some sort of containment device for prisoners, I assume? A cell of some sort? There is a force field around it..
Electricity? An Angel has no fear of the elements. Except the cold...
This must be "Mercury", one of the planets of the Sol system. Heh, so small.
Another great invention of the Mortals, the "anvil". Those who excel in metalwork can craft great weapons here.
Sleek beds that can stack on top of each other. This looks similar to the beds at the Protectorate academy..
These two metal machines are broken beyond repair. They look like they might fall at any second, too..!
Wait, this is Leda.. She is the one who gave me the Matter Manipulator before.........
This smoke is getting in my way.. Where is it coming from?
This cabinet is full of small lights. Looks pretty advanced to me..
Some type of Mortal vehicle, but it does not seem to work.
An iron barred door, for keeping prisoners in.
You can rather magically spawn a chef out of nowhere!
An extremely basic wardrobe.
Flame.. A wondrous light.
The covers on this bed are warm indeed. Truly a great place to lay and rest.
It appears to be one of the Glitch kind, standing in a weird way.
Woah, those are some large featheres.. What Mortal bird dropped these?
Hmm, this helps me remember my time on Earth...
The machine has writing displayed on it called "Starbound".
From the writing on the screen, this seems to be a "personal" computer. I am not the prying type, so I will leave this be.
You can rather magically spawn a fishy-one out of nowhere!
This vending machine sells sugary drinks and snacks. These often keep Mortals energized and awake, or so I hear. Is it purely beneficial?
This is a fire fluffalo egg. Mature fire fluffalos are a great source of scorched cores.
There are many insects living in and around this chair. I better leave them be.
This..almost seems like the exact same thing an Angel painted many eras ago..
This trap spews a deadly ice blast. I need to avoid this blast at all costs..
An electrical barrier. It looks dangerous, but I feel rather..safe.
If I am confused on something, I can easily ask this kind fishy-one for advice or tips.
This poster shows a "UFO".
What a strange looking fountain...
These student lockers are perfect for storing away useful items. This particular one belongs to me.
These shelves contain many good items.
Exposed wires! I better be careful around this damaged ceiling.
This is a guitar! I do not have time to try it out, though.
Dripping blood?!
This ice appears to have some sort of special protection. It will not melt any time soon.
This plaque describes "Study in Female Hylotlgy", and references dates and names. Something related to art, perhaps?
This must be "Saturn", one of the planets of the Sol system. The planetary rings around this planet are fascinating..!
This Grand Protector has a rather serious look.
This iron table is used for crafting various equipment.
This rickety door looks highly unstable. Does it even keep the weather out?
What ever is so hazardous around here?
Each of these banners represents a race. The ones I am sworn to protect. The Novakid flag is missing, though..
An "exit sign"! This way to leave, I assume.
The metalwork on this lamp is beautiful!
You can rather magically spawn a leafy-one out of nowhere!
What ever this strange metal machine used to do - it does not work anymore.
Wait, this appears to be a broken "register". Are there any Pixels inside?
This looks as if something escaped from this container..from the inside.
An unlabelled tally chart. I wonder what the tallies stand for?
I feel like I will not be able to stand on this platform for long, so I better be ready to jump and fly!
You can rather magically spawn a feathered-one out of nowhere!
I am not sure how to use this or what it is.
Quite a fluffy couch! Almost like sinking into clouds...
This door reeks of death and despair. I dare not get close to it or touch it, for it looks like it could summon a Demon at any second..
This is either a picture or a painting of a cityscape. I will admit, the view is decent.
This Mortal Human looks important. Too bad I do not know who he is.
This old tree is said to be as old as the academy itself. I admire it for this feat alone.
An extremely old painting of some animals.
This screen is making a strange sound while showing dancing patterns. Is something wrong?
Water, the life force on every planet.. Coming right out of this mysterious statue!
The crystal atop this bookcase lights faintly. Maybe I can read one of these books with such a small light source...
Crude depictions of the Florans while hunting.
This Apex woman seems to be happy, but not.. Ah, Mortals.. Their conflicting emotions are amusing!
These figures are nice to look at. They are adorable.
An electric hanging light made from copper.
This tentacle creature looks like the Ruin. Hmph, foul being...
There are sharp Avian spears here on this rack. The feathered-ones know how to make their weapons!
You can rather magically spawn a furry-one out of nowhere!
The natural curve of this slime chair is fascinating, but sitting in it is a whole different story.
This device scans hands, it seems. But, for what purpose?
This special table is for crafting specialized equipment. I am sure I can figure out how to use it properly..
I think this Avian emblem is supposed to represent "water".
This flower bed has a sickly-sweet smell...
An interesting support beam.. The design is quite..unique.
Some sort of creepy altar. Begone, Demons! ..If there are any...
This must be an Altar for the Avians.. Those feathered-ones, they do not even know their "god" is not real. The Cultivator was and is, very real.
This station can be used to call for all kinds of helpers. This could greatly help my cause!
I should not touch this chest more than I have to. It appears to be quite toxic.
This mushroom appears to be of Agaran origin, the shroomy-ones.
What a weirdly-shaped cabinet.. But, it works nonetheless.
This flower seems to produce light that is similar to a sun. Fascinating!
This former Grand Protector looks old, but the spark in his eyes tell otherwise.
This must be "Sun" the star that is in the centre of the Sol system. It is the life-giving light.
Fairy lights spell out "Waz". What does "Waz" mean?
This machine is demanding to scan my eyes.. Well, hmph, if you insist! Look into my bright, glorious eyes!
I am unable to tell if the sheets are made from real animal hide.
The flashing coming from this furry doll is very supicious. Perhaps I should tear it apart and figure out what's inside?
This unusual bed is actually quite comforting to sleep in. The plants help add to the bedding.
The plaque for this picture reads, "Esther Bright - Former Grand Protector". Curious.
